title: Flowstead flowsheet
description: The master copy of a Flowstead project (decision D5). Mirrors android/core app.flowstead.core.model.Flowsheet and engine Flowstead.Engine.Contracts.Flowsheet. All numbers SI.

atmosphericPressurePa.description: Reference for gauge pressures shown in this project

reactions.description: Reactions reactors can use; each reactor lists the ids it runs in refs.reactions (comma-separated).

hypotheticals.description: User-defined pseudo-components (HYSYS hypotheticals); each name is also in compounds.

liquidDensity.description: Liquid density method. Absent: the engine default (DWSIM's Rackett and experimental data, with Flowstead's supercritical rule for cubic packages). "costald": COSTALD for every liquid, as HYSYS does for hydrocarbons.

volumeShift.description: Cubic EOS volume shift. Absent: DWSIM's Peneloux shift on vapour and liquid (PR, SRK, PR/LK). "none": the plain EOS, as HYSYS's Peng-Robinson reports densities and Z.

vapourViscosity.description: Vapour viscosity method. Absent: DWSIM's (Lucas, with the Jossi-Stiel-Thodos pressure correction). "lge": Lee-Gonzalez-Eakin, the natural-gas correlation (PR, SRK, PR/LK, NRTL, UNIQUAC).

sizingCriteria.description: App-only line-sizing limits by service (gas, liquid, twoPhase), each a set of optional Specs in SI: maxVelocity, minVelocity (m/s), maxMomentumFlux (kg/m·s²), maxFrictionGradient (Pa/m), maxMach, erosionalC (API RP 14E). Not part of the solved model; the engine ignores it.

documentInfo.description: App-only title block for every project document (data sheets, PFD, H&MB): company, project, projectNumber, client, site, preparedBy, checkedBy, approvedBy, pfdNumber, hmbNumber, revision (strings). Not part of the solved model; the engine ignores it.

tables.description: App-only property tables drawn on the flowsheet and the printed PFD: objectId, keys (result keys to show), dx and dy (offset from the object, world units). Not part of the solved model; the engine ignores it.

si.description: Value in the SI base unit

unit.description: Unit id the user typed it in (display only), e.g. barg

specs.description: User specifications (SI). Streams: temperature, pressure, vapourFraction, massEnthalpy, molarFlow, massFlow. Valve: outletPressure | pressureDrop. Heater/cooler: outletTemperature | duty, pressureDrop. Pump: outletPressure | pressureRise, efficiency. Compressor: outletPressure | pressureRise | pressureRatio, efficiency. Expander: outletPressure | pressureDrop | pressureRatio, efficiency. Heat exchanger: duty | hotOutletTemperature | coldOutletTemperature, hotPressureDrop, coldPressureDrop. Splitter: split1, split2. Pipe segment: length, innerDiameter, outerDiameter, elevationChange, roughness, increments, heatTransferCoefficient + ambientTemperature. Orifice plate: orificeDiameter, pipeDiameter. Adjust: target, tolerance, minimum, maximum.

composition.description: Overall mole fractions by compound (material streams); must sum to 1

refs.description: References to other objects. Adjust: manipulatedObject, manipulatedSpec (a spec key on that object), controlledObject, controlledProperty (a result key). Its specs: target, optional tolerance, minimum, maximum (SI). Method choices: pipe segment correlation (beggs_brill | lockhart_martinelli | petalas_aziz), orifice plate taps (flange | corner | radius). App-only (ignored by the engine): pipe nps, schedule, service (gas | liquid | two_phase).

sheet.description: App-only data-sheet fields (free text): documentNumber, revision, revisionDescription, service, notes, designPressure, designTemperature, material, corrosionAllowance, insulation, codes. Not part of the solved model; the engine ignores it.

Hypothetical.description: Give normalBoilingPoint (K) or molecularWeight, optionally specificGravity (60 °F/60 °F); DWSIM's correlations estimate the rest. criticalTemperature (K), criticalPressure (Pa) and acentricFactor override the estimates.

stoichiometry.description: Coefficient by compound; negative for reactants

phase.description: Equilibrium reactions: vapour or liquid only

conversion.description: Conversion reactions: fraction of the base compound converted

approachTemperature.description: Equilibrium reactions: K (temperature difference) added to T when evaluating K

forwardA.description: Kinetic: pre-exponential factor; rate in mol/(m³·s), concentrations in mol/m³
